app.name: Corporate Weather
app.shortDescription: DACH workplace weather radar for visible restructuring and layoff-risk signals.
app.longDescription: Corporate Weather helps users understand visible workplace-weather signals across the DACH market. It turns public, evidence-style signals such as hiring activity, company communications, DACH business press indicators, and workplace review patterns into a calm, explainable report. The app does not predict layoffs and does not provide legal advice. It highlights visible risk signals, calm counter-signals, confidence, missing evidence, and what to watch next.
targetUsers: Employee representatives and works council-adjacent researchers
People teams and internal strategists reviewing public DACH signals
DACH market observers comparing visible restructuring indicators
app.valueProposition: Corporate Weather reduces fragmented public research into a calm, explainable workplace-weather report for DACH companies.

authentication.description: The app does not require user login or third-party account access.

userInputs: Company name entered by the user
Selected demo company or internal app navigation state
dataHandling.storage: The app does not intentionally store user queries or reports in an application database.
dataHandling.sharing: The app does not sell personal data. Hosting and platform providers may process operational logs needed to operate the app.
dataHandling.privacySummary: Corporate Weather asks for a company name and generates a DACH workplace-weather report. Users should not enter personal or sensitive information.

safetyAndCompliance.usagePolicySummary: The app is read-only and informational. It does not make employment decisions, predict layoffs, provide legal advice, or modify external systems.
safetyAndCompliance.disclaimer: Signal analysis only. Not a prediction or legal advice.
riskMitigations: Uses cautious risk language such as visible risk signals and watchlist
Shows confidence and missing evidence on every report
Includes calm counter-signals and score guardrails
Prevents generic weak signals from producing high-risk scores
Uses deterministic demo mode for stable public review and demo behavior

testPrompts.expectedResult: The app does not crash or show 'No results'. It creates a cautious low-confidence report and offers calibrated demo fallback reports.

app.reviewNotes: Corporate Weather is a read-only DACH workplace signal analysis app. It does not predict layoffs, does not provide legal advice, and does not modify external systems. The app currently uses deterministic demo/simulated public-signal analysis to demonstrate the product workflow safely and consistently. It asks only for a company name and returns an explainable workplace-weather report with confidence, missing evidence, and guardrails.
